title: VTC Groups — Managers — Remove — payload
description: A manager steps down, or an administrator who manages every group withdraws another member's appointment as a group's manager. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

entryId.description: The manager whose appointment ends: the signer's own entry to step down.

Response.title: VTC Groups — Managers — Remove — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/groups/managers/remove/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/groups/managers/remove/0.1#response.

managers.description: The group's managers after the change. Entries holding `vtc.groups.manage` qualified to this group, read from the access-control list; administrators who manage every group are not listed.
